RowLevelPolicies.PolicyName: customers can read their own favourites
RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: SCHEMA_FIELD vs AUTH rule — compiled into a read filter, so this is isolation, not a hidden list. A wishlist is a statement about someone's intentions and shouldn't be readable by other customers or by staff without cause.

RowLevelPolicies.PolicyName: signed-in customers can add a favourite
RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: Write access is User. CustomerId must be stamped from the authenticated caller by the app; a client that sends someone else's id creates a row it then cannot read, which is harmless but pointless.

RowLevelPolicies.PolicyName: customers can remove their own favourites
RowLevelPolicies.PolicyDescription: Delete is how un-favouriting works, so customers need it — scoped to their own rows.
Right-to-erasure and cleanup. Deliberately no admin *read* policy: staff have no business browsing wishlists, and adding one later is a decision, not an oversight to correct.
